name: Valloire
description: Valloire is a real working mountain village in the Maurienne valley. Stone-built chalets, a pedestrianised centre, 17th-century Baroque church (Notre-Dame de l'Assomption with ornate gilded interior). Home to the highest brewery in France — Galibier beer brewed with glacier water. Linked with Valmeinier to form Galibier-Thabor (160km, 90 runs, 70% above 2,000m). 30 lifts including high-speed quads and 2 gondolas — short queues even in school holidays. Selles blue run (6.8km, 2,410m to 1,725m) is one of the longest in Savoie.

overview.atmosphere: Authentic Savoyard mountain village with a stunning Baroque church. Its own brewery — the highest in France — making Galibier beer with glacier water. 160km linked domain with Valmeinier. Short queues, great value.

beyond_skiing.ice_skating: Outdoor ice rink in village centre
beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Cheese tastings at local fromageries, scenic gondola rides for pedestrians, Saint-Jean-de-Maurienne day trip (30 min), snowshoeing
